review_candidates.title: Senior Director, People & Culture
review_candidates.description: At The Coca-Cola Company, we believe that our people are the key to our success. With a rich history spanning over 136 years, we have cultivated a vibrant, inclusive, and dynamic culture that drives our global leadership in the beverage industry. We are currently seeking a Senior Director, People & Culture to join our team. This role is not just about implementing strategies; it is about shaping the future of our organization. We are looking for a strategic and influential leader who can enhance our employee experience, foster an inclusive and high-performing culture, and drive impactful people strategies that enable business growth across Nigeria and Egypt. If you are excited about making a meaningful impact and transforming the way we work, we would love to hear from you. What You'll Do For Us Serve as the strategic People & Culture partner for business leaders and teams across Nigeria and Egypt, driving business performance through talent, culture, capability, and organization effectiveness strategies. Partner with senior stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and develop innovative people solutions aligned with organizational priorities. Lead and influence change management initiatives, ensuring successful adoption while taking into account employee experience, local cultural nuances, and organizational complexity. Coach and advise senior leaders on talent, culture, organizational effectiveness, leadership development, team performance, and employee engagement. Collaborate closely with the Global Culture & Engagement team, leadership teams, and People & Culture communities to implement listening strategies and translate insights into meaningful actions. Partner with the PACS team, Talent & Development team, Bottling Partners, and other key stakeholders to create and sustain an engaging employee experience and communication strategy. Lead organizational design, workforce planning, and capability-building initiatives that support business transformation and long-term growth. Drive robust succession planning and leadership pipeline development to ensure a strong and diverse talent bench. Foster a winning mindset and high-performance culture through strategic talent management, employee engagement, and inclusion initiatives. Ensure compliance with local employment legislation, labor relations requirements, and company policies across both markets. Stay connected to external trends and leading practices, continuously evolving organizational approaches to culture, engagement, talent, and communications. Qualifications & Requirements Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 10+ years of progressive Human Resources leadership experience within a complex multinational organization. Proven experience partnering with senior executives and leadership teams to drive business and people strategies. Strong expertise in HR business partnering, executive coaching, organizational effectiveness, talent management, and change leadership. Demonstrated success leading transformation, culture, engagement, and capability-building initiatives. Experience in talent acquisition, employee and labor relations, communications, and performance management. Knowledge of total rewards, succession planning, workforce planning, and organizational capability & development. Experience working across multiple markets and navigating complex matrix organizations. Strong understanding of employment legislation and labor practices within diverse and dynamic business environments. Exceptional stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills. What We Can Do For You Exposure to World-Class Leaders: Opportunity to partner with senior leaders across the Coca-Cola system, expanding your network and exposing you to best-in-class leadership practices, emerging technologies, and innovative ways of working. Strategic Impact: Ability to directly influence business outcomes through people, culture, and organizational transformation initiatives across two of Africa's most significant markets. Inclusive Workplace: The Coca-Cola Company is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought, experience, and background is celebrated and valued. Community of Belonging: We are an organization that believes our ability to continually grow depends on creating an environment where people feel safe, empowered, and inspired to bring their best selves to work every day. Development & Growth: Access to challenging assignments, leadership development opportunities, and meaningful career experiences across a truly global organization. HR Business, Influencing, Organizational Capability, Organizational Effectiveness, People Management, Performance Culture, Performance Management (PM) Location(s): Egypt City/Cities Travel Required: 00% - 25% Relocation Provided: No Job Posting End Date August 28, 2026 Our Purpose And Growth Culture We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola. review_candidates.title: Senior Accountant And Finance Officer
review_candidates.description: Role Description The Senior Accountant and Finance Officer at ANA Media Hub is responsible for overseeing day-to-day financial operations, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, and maintaining compliance with relevant accounting standards and regulations. This remote role includes preparing and reviewing financial statements, managing general ledger entries, reconciling accounts, and overseeing accounts payable and receivable. The position also focuses on budget preparation and monitoring, cash flow management, and financial forecasting to support strategic decision-making. The Senior Accountant and Finance Officer will collaborate with internal teams, respond to financial inquiries, prepare reports for leadership, support audits, and recommend process improvements to enhance financial efficiency and control. This is a full-time remote role, requiring consistent collaboration through digital communication tools and adherence to deadlines across time zones. Qualifications Demonstrated expertise in core accounting functions, including general ledger management, account reconciliation, financial reporting, and month-end and year-end closing activities. Strong financial planning and analysis capabilities, such as budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cash flow monitoring to support informed business decisions. Proficiency in using accounting and finance software, spreadsheets, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn and adapt to new digital platforms quickly. Solid knowledge of relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and compliance requirements, with experience supporting external and internal audits. Effective communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to present financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders and work cross-functionally in a remote environment. High level of integrity, attention to detail, and organizational skills, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines consistently. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (such as CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) are an advantage. Prior experience in a senior accounting or finance role, preferably within media, technology, or related industries, is highly beneficial.

review_candidates.title: Sales Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Solar Tower designs and installs on-grid and off-grid solar power systems across Egypt, providing high-quality solar energy products and turnkey installation services. Founded in 2020, the company focuses on renewable energy solutions that support sustainable and cost-effective power for homes, businesses, and communities. Solar Tower also delivers engineering consultations to help clients plan and optimize solar projects. Team members collaborate on impactful work that advances clean energy adoption and long-term environmental and economic benefits. Role Description This full-time Sales Specialist role is a hybrid position based in Alexandria, Egypt, with some work-from-home flexibility. The Sales Specialist identifies and qualifies new leads, conducts client meetings, and presents tailored solar energy solutions for residential, commercial, and community projects. Daily tasks include managing the sales pipeline, preparing proposals and quotations, following up on opportunities, and coordinating with engineering and installation teams to ensure smooth project handover. The role involves maintaining strong customer relationships, responding to inquiries, and providing product and service information that supports informed decisions. The Sales Specialist also participates in sales reporting, market research, and occasional trainings or events to promote Solar Tower’s offerings. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to engage clients, build trust, and respond effectively to questions and concerns. Candidates should possess proven Sales capabilities, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing deals in a target-driven environment. Candidates should possess Sales Management and Training skills to help organize pipelines, support team performance, and share product or process knowledge when needed. Relevant experience in renewable energy, engineering services, or technical solutions sales is beneficial. Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Alexandria, Egypt, manage time independently, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. Proficiency with CRM tools, basic MS Office applications, and data-driven decision-making is an advantage. A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience in sales.

review_candidates.title: Lawyer
review_candidates.description: Company Description The lawyer Nedal Mandour is a legal practice based in Cairo, Egypt, providing professional legal services to individuals and organizations. The practice focuses on delivering clear, practical legal advice and effective representation in line with local laws and regulations. Clients are supported through a range of legal matters with attention to detail, confidentiality, and ethics. Team members collaborate closely to offer high-quality service and maintain long-term client relationships. The work environment encourages ongoing learning and professional growth within the legal field. Role Description This full-time Lawyer role is a hybrid position based in Cairo, Egypt, with a combination of in-office work and some work-from-home flexibility. The Lawyer will handle case preparation, draft legal documents and contracts, conduct legal research, and provide legal opinions and advice to clients. Daily responsibilities include reviewing and analyzing legal issues, attending client meetings, representing clients before relevant authorities or courts as required, and maintaining accurate case files and documentation. The role also involves negotiating settlements where appropriate, collaborating with colleagues on complex matters, and staying up to date with legal developments affecting clients. The Lawyer is expected to manage deadlines, maintain professional communication, and uphold ethical and confidentiality standards. Qualifications Strong legal research and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret laws, regulations, and legal precedents. Proficiency in drafting and reviewing legal documents, contracts, pleadings, and client correspondence. Experience in client counseling, case management, and representation before courts or administrative authorities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are highly beneficial. Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent) from an accredited institution; admission to practice law in Egypt is required. Sound judgment, ethical integrity, and a high level of professionalism in managing sensitive matters. Ability to work independently and collaboratively, prioritize tasks, and meet strict deadlines in a hybrid work setting. Prior experience in civil, commercial, or corporate law in Egypt is an advantage.
